audit_target: Stuck Thinking / Hung Research Task Forensic Reproduction

root_causes_discovered.name: Missing State Machine Transition to IDLE in query_llm and _process_command
root_causes_discovered.mechanism: When user command falls through to query_llm, state_changed('thinking') is emitted, but state_changed('idle') is never emitted upon stream conclusion.

root_causes_discovered.name: Missing State Machine Transition to IDLE in _run_research
root_causes_discovered.mechanism: _run_research emits state_changed('thinking') at start, but exits without emitting state_changed('idle'), leaving HUD permanently stuck in ACTIVE // THINKING.

root_causes_discovered.name: Orphaned Task and Broken Stop Button for Deep Research
root_causes_discovered.mechanism: handle_research() spawns an untracked asyncio task without assigning to self._current_command_task. Pressing Stop button checks self._current_command_task which is None, failing to cancel active research.

root_causes_discovered.name: Missing Task Watchdog, Idle Timeout, and Deadlines
root_causes_discovered.mechanism: No watchdog monitors running tasks. If web scraping, URL fetching, or local Ollama reasoning blocks or exceeds 180s, the task hangs indefinitely without TIMEOUT or FAIL terminal state.

root_causes_discovered.name: Unbounded Non-Streaming LLM Synthesis in Deep Research
root_causes_discovered.mechanism: _run_research calls query_llm(synth_prompt, stream_to_ui=False). The UI receives 0 token chunks and 0 progress updates, remaining frozen on 'Neural core synthesizing...' for minutes until Ollama socket times out.

root_causes_discovered.name: Ollama num_ctx Default Overflow
root_causes_discovered.mechanism: query_llm does not pass num_ctx: 8192, causing Ollama to exceed default context on multi-source research dossiers, failing with silent read timeouts.
